metadata.insertion_point: fix + refresh exactly at the step boundary, i.e. after a self-contained lam,(1-2*lam),lam drift sandwich, so the accumulated drift is (i+1)*dt
metadata.note: trajectories are deterministic: same seed gives the same flags/delta_h; `field` is the gauge field AFTER the trajectory (accepted proposal, or unchanged on rejection), `plaq` and `flag` are the post-Metropolis values
